segments.name: Marmaxx
segments.description: Operates TJ Maxx, Marshalls and Sierra off-price stores and e-commerce sites selling family apparel, accessories, home fashions and outdoor gear in the U.S.
segments.evidence: Our TJ Maxx and Marshalls chains in the United States ("Marmaxx") are collectively the largest off-price retailer in the United States with a total of 2,603 stores.

segments.name: HomeGoods
segments.description: Operates HomeGoods and Homesense chains, off-price retailers of home fashions in the U.S.
segments.evidence: Our HomeGoods segment operates HomeGoods and Homesense chains in the U.S.

segments.name: TJX Canada
segments.description: Operates Winners, HomeSense and Marshalls off-price chains selling family apparel and home fashions in Canada.
segments.evidence: Our TJX Canada segment operates the Winners, HomeSense and Marshalls chains in Canada.

segments.name: TJX International
segments.description: Operates TK Maxx and Homesense chains in Europe and TK Maxx in Australia selling apparel and home fashions.
segments.evidence: Our TJX International segment operates the TK Maxx and Homesense chains in Europe and the TK Maxx chain in Australia.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay TJX for merchandise purchased in its stores and online, with net sales also including an immaterial amount of other revenues such as the TJX-branded credit card program.
revenueModel.evidence: Net sales also include an immaterial amount of other revenues that represent less than 1 % of total revenues, including revenue generated by the TJX-branded credit card program.
